APPENDIX B / COMPLETE UML CLASS DIAGRAM
All classes with attributes, methods (typed parameters), inheritance, associations and dependencies
Notation: "-" private, "+" public | hollow triangle = inheritance (IS-A) | hollow diamond = aggregation | filled diamond = composition
solid line with open arrow = association (class keeps the other class in a field) | dashed arrow = dependency (uses it as a parameter, local variable or return type)
Dependencies not drawn: Main also uses Customer, Employee, Product and Order; Store also creates Book, Electronics, Clothing, Customer and Employee.
